title: Aureline M5 experiment-run-row component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the experiment-run-row family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). An experiment run row names where a run came from and where it stands so a run never hides its notebook / script / task origin, its code revision, or that a run was imported or manually attached. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
